note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1925 original English description. The original is Nasutitermes (Convexitermes) mazaruniensis, sp. nov., type locality Kartabo, British Guiana, described from several alates and soldiers from two nests and 1 king and queen; later transferred to the genus Coatitermes by Fontes 1982. The worker is not described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier nasus brown, contrasting less strongly with the head than in N. kartaboensis, its base rather thick, conical, covered with short hairs that are shorter than the long hairs on the head. Very difficult to distinguish from the soldier of N. kartaboensis; the alate differs in its distinctly shorter wings (forewing 6.20—6.73 mm, versus 7.70—7.87 mm in N. kartaboensis), and in the body length including wings 6.95—7.20 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval; frontal gland pore slit-like, forked at the end. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 and segment 2 equal in length, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Eyes rather large and prominent, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather large, separated from the eyes by less than 1/3 of their width. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, median line faint. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, sides and posterior margin rather straight, angles rather sharp. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wings smoky. Abdominal tergites slightly paler than the head. Measurements (mm): body length including wings 6.95—7.20, body length excluding wings 5.50—6.00, head length 0.87—0.97, head width 0.77—0.85, antennal length 1.43, eye diameter 0.27—0.29, pronotum length 0.41—0.43, pronotum width 0.63—0.68, hind tibia length 0.93—1.06, forewing length 6.20—6.73, forewing width 1.80—1.83.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval in dorsal view, slightly narrowed at the antennal bases; lateral profile of head and nasus nearly straight or slightly convex. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 2 and segment 4 equal in length, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Nasus brown, contrasting less strongly with the head than in N. kartaboensis; nasus conical, its base fairly thick, covered with short hairs that are shorter than the long hairs on the head; head also with several longer setae. Thorax pale. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents; tergites covered with fairly long hairs, with a row of setae on the posterior margin. Measurements (mm): total body length 3.30—3.50, head length 1.00—1.07, head width 0.54—0.57, antennal length 1.00, pronotum width 0.33, hind tibia length 0.56—0.60.
